title: Copper Tools and Armor Remover
description: Datapack that removes copper Tools and Armor recepes and loot
body:
You don't like that the new copper tools and armor make you feel like you're playing with some kind of McCreator mods? Just install this data pack that deletes them!

Very simple datapack but if you lazy for doing it by yourself...

It removes recipes and loot spawn for:
- Copper Axe
- Copper Boots
- Copper Chestplate
- Copper Helmet
- Copper Hoe
- Copper Leggings
- Copper Pickaxe
- Copper Shovel
- Copper Spear
- Copper Sword
- Copper Horse Armor 
- Copper Nautilus Armor
